scenario_description: Elena is scheduled for a half-day substitute assignment at Dominion Middle School on April 13 and initially has a dental appointment that prevents her from staying for the afternoon. A possible afternoon opening is mentioned while staffing is still unsettled, so acting then would be premature. After the dental office cancels Elena's appointment, the coordinator confirms that she can extend her existing assignment in the same classroom through 3:15 PM for an additional $96. The opportunity becomes sufficiently observable in event4 by connecting the canceled appointment with the confirmed same-site opening. Event5 adds a response time and confirms that no extra travel or material pickup is required. Accepting remains optional but would give Elena additional income with little added travel.

parameter.subject: April 13 half-day assignment at Dominion
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Monday, April 13, 2026, at Dominion Middle School. Please report to the main office by 7:20 AM and cover Maya Chen's classes in Room 214 until 11:30 AM. Your substitute parking permission will remain valid in the east lot for the time you are working.

parameter.subject: Possible afternoon coverage at Dominion on April 13
parameter.body: Dominion may also need coverage in Room 214 after your morning assignment on April 13. Staffing is still being reviewed, so the afternoon opening is not confirmed and no response is needed yet.

parameter.subject: April 13 dental appointment canceled
parameter.body: We need to cancel your dental cleaning scheduled for Monday, April 13, from 1:30 PM to 2:30 PM because your hygienist will be out of the office. There is no charge for the cancellation. We will contact you later with optional replacement dates.

parameter.subject: Confirmed extension available for April 13 assignment
parameter.body: The afternoon Room 214 coverage at Dominion is now confirmed. Because you are already assigned there that morning, you may extend your day from 11:45 AM through 3:15 PM for an additional $96. This is optional and will be offered to another substitute if you do not want it. Reply to me if you would like the extension.

parameter.subject: Room 214 details for Monday afternoon
parameter.body: Luis told me you may be offered the afternoon extension on Monday. The lesson materials will already be in Room 214, and your east-lot parking permission will cover the full day, so there is no additional pickup or school-to-school trip. Luis needs a decision by 10:00 AM tomorrow before he contacts the next available substitute.
